headword: {七人|しちにん}の{侍|さむらい}

definitions.explanation: An epic film by {黒澤明|くろさわあきら} in which poor farmers, threatened by bandits, hire seven masterless samurai to defend their village. One of the most influential films ever made; its story was remade as the Western The Magnificent Seven.

examples.japanese: 『{七人|しちにん}の{侍|さむらい}』⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}た→見る：00283_miru⟧。
『{七人|しちにん}の{侍|さむらい}』⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{黒澤明|くろさわあきら}→黒澤明：31117_kurosawaakira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{代表作|だいひょうさく}→代表作：09952_daihyousaku⟧だ。
examples.english: Seven Samurai is Akira Kurosawa's best-known work.

examples.japanese: 『{七人|しちにん}の{侍|さむらい}』⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{農民|のうみん}→農民：03759_noumin⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{雇|やと}われた→雇う：02320_yatou⟧⟦{侍|さむらい}→侍：10499_samurai⟧たち⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{野武士|のぶし}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{村|むら}→村：02261_mura⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{守|まも}る→守る：01986_mamoru⟧。
examples.english: In Seven Samurai, samurai hired by farmers defend a village against bandits.

notes:
PRONUNCIATION:
- The title is read しちにん, not ななにん

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Stars {三船敏郎|みふねとしろう} and {志村喬|しむらたかし}; it runs about three and a half hours
- The plot of gathering a team one by one and defending a place against attack became a model for countless later films
